name: ask-claude
title: Ask Claude
description: Chat with Claude using your own Anthropic API key, with saved conversations and every model your key can use.
author: kushal_somaliya

commands.name: ask-claude
commands.title: Ask Claude
commands.description: Ask Claude anything and keep the conversation going.

commands.name: update-extension
commands.title: Update Ask Claude
commands.description: Check GitHub for a newer version of this extension and install it.

preferences.name: sourceFolder
preferences.title: Extension Folder
preferences.description: Where this extension's code lives on your Mac (the folder you ran npm run dev in).

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Anthropic API Key
preferences.description: Your own key from platform.claude.com (starts with sk-ant-). Raycast stores it securely on this Mac; it is only ever sent to api.anthropic.com.

preferences.name: webSearch
preferences.title: Web Search
preferences.label: Let Claude search the web when a question needs current info
preferences.description: Searches cost about $0.01 each plus tokens, billed to your API key.

preferences.name: webFetch
preferences.title: Read Links
preferences.label: Let Claude open and read links you share or that search finds
preferences.description: No extra fee; the page text counts as tokens (capped at about 30k per page).

preferences.name: maxSearches
preferences.title: Max Searches per Question
preferences.description: Upper limit on web searches for one question (1–100).

preferences.name: searchCountry
preferences.title: Search Country
preferences.description: Two-letter country code used to localise search results, e.g. IN or US. Leave empty to skip.

preferences.name: aiTitles
preferences.title: Chat Titles
preferences.label: Let Claude write a short title for each new chat
preferences.description: One tiny extra request per chat, using the fastest model your key has.
